scope: Confirmation-only fixed compiler rewrite; metadata-restricted fresh exact model families, not architecture-disjoint and not native PassBench acceptance
compiler_comparison: Separate isolated compiler checkouts; all production compilation source files pinned; only tensor.js differs. Identical current importer-generated programs and measurement runtime for both variants.
inputs: Original source replay, no input mutation, complete output structure
order: Seeded shuffled order of exact distinct executable fingerprints per graph/repeat; aliases share measurements
failure_policy: Retain every selected graph and every compile/reference/correctness/timing failure; any failure disables an aggregate speedup claim; no replacement or outcome-based eligibility
selection: No training, ranking or tuning; both source variants fixed before any selected graph is compiled
metrics: CUDA-event stream elapsed ms including dispatch gaps
primary_summary: Exact-model family-balanced geometric mean baseline/candidate median ratio; repeated timings are descriptive, not a calibrated confidence interval
declaration_status: Finalized before confirmation source scanning or compilation
